gate_dsh4_03.required_outcome: legal-action distillation (accepted-set mass, verifier-backed ranking, entropy/reliability-aware KD, +DEFER) demonstrates value over the nondistilled certified controller
gate_dsh4_03.observed_outcome: no_go_defer -- neither verifier_ranking_kd nor verifier_ranking_kd_defer cleared the acceptance bar; both teacher-imitation arms (teacher_argmax, offline_conditional_kd) changed 100% of eligible decisions but were wrong 28/30 times; verifier_ranking_kd was prediction-identical to the baseline on every eligible decision and was correctly rejected rather than credited

reason: DSH4-04's own Decision statement scopes the question to 'after legal-action distillation has demonstrated value' -- an explicit entry condition, not a general acquisition-policy question. SLM-388 (DSH4-03) is the only completed distillation experiment in this line and returned no_go_defer: no teacher-informed arm (teacher_argmax, offline_conditional_kd, verifier_ranking_kd, verifier_ranking_kd_defer) cleared its acceptance gates. The only arm that did improve held-out CAP2-proxy quality (hard_accepted_set) is a disjoint-trained hard-label frequency prior used as DSH4-03's reference control, not a distillation arm -- it does not establish that legal-action distillation (teacher- or verifier-informed supervision) has demonstrated value. Running DSH4-04's selective-acquisition comparison (uniform vs. student entropy vs. divergence vs. low accepted rank vs. verifier failure cone vs. high regret vs. hybrid, at equal teacher-query budget) would compare acquisition policies for a teacher signal that has not itself been shown worth acquiring. Per this repository's evidence-before-implementation contract, the DSH4-04 architecture is not authorized to build against an unmet entry condition.
downstream_effect: DSH4-04 (SLM-389) stays closed pending a distillation line that clears DSH4-03-equivalent gates. No selective-acquisition policy, uniform-vs-selective comparator, or query-budget harness is implemented.
reopening_conditions: a legal-action distillation experiment (DSH4-03 rerun with a non-synthetic/real teacher, or a successor issue) returns a `go` verdict with at least one teacher-informed arm (teacher_argmax, offline_conditional_kd, verifier_ranking_kd, or verifier_ranking_kd_defer) clearing every DSH4-03 acceptance gate: >=5% of eligible choices changed, correct changes exceed wrong changes, held-out CAP2-proxy (or the frozen dsh3-13 suite) improves across seeds, and the comparison is not prediction-identical-rejected
